title: Optimal Control of Hydro-Electric Power Plants with Uncontrolled Spillways
summary: In this paper, we study an optimal control problem for a cascade of hydroelectric power plants with reversible turbines and uncontrolled spillways. The system dynamics are governed by a linear control model subject to path constraints. The aim is to maximize the power production profit while respecting operational restrictions on reservoir water levels. The challenge is the presence of uncontrollable spillways: their discontinuous nature and the fact that they are activated at the state boundary prevent the application of known necessary conditions of optimality.
